name: Compound Pendulum
desc: Explore the chaotic motion of up to four connected rigid rods, then compare as many as four independently configured pendulum experiments side by side with shared time, colorful trajectories and energy tracking.
shortDesc: Compare up to four multirod pendulums with different initial angles, lengths, and angular speeds.
learningObjectives: Explore nonlinear motion of one to four connected rigid rods
Compare trajectories and the sensitivity to small differences in initial conditions
Distinguish changes in physical energy from view-only camera scaling
Investigate how viscous joint friction dissipates mechanical energy
modelAssumptions: Uniform slender rigid rods with equal linear mass density
Viscous hinge damping without air resistance or collision geometry
Independently evolved systems with synchronized simulation time
